notes.title: WINDFALLERS
notes.content:

[olist]
Sign contract
Get thrown by a trebuchet
Complete the contract
Get paid
Make new friends
[/olist]


📯Featuring📯

"Sword Time"
It's like "bullet time" but with swords. 

"Trebuchets"
Do I really need to define this? Can you girlfriend throw you 300 yards? No? I didnt think so.

"Stealth Assault"
Like when you're stealthy until your found, then you're a whirlwind of steel and death.

"Infinite Ammo"
It's just like regular ammo, just infinite 


But seriously, enjoy the prototype demo! I know there's a lot of other games you could be playing and I appreciate you choosing to play this one 😁

And come give a shout on the Warcube server
(because I do not yet have a server for Windfallers, and I would feel pretentious to name the server after myself...)
Discord Fam 🍰
